title: Steam Backlog Age for Installed Games
dataSources: Steam activity and achievements (`steam:activity`), Chess.com games (`chesscom:game`), online-go matches (`ogs:game`), and poker home-game hands or settlements (`pokerhome:session`).
app: Gaming and play telemetry from Steam, Chess.com, Online-Go servers, and poker home-game logs sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and export files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=steam:activity
| search installed="true" last_played=*
| stats latest(_time) as last_seen count as events by game_name
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_seen)/86400,1)
| sort - days_since
description: Shows which gamess have gone quiet for played installed games.
value: Backlog age for installed games surfaces the titles using storage and attention without ever getting a real session.
implementation: Send played installed games events to `index=personal` and alert when the gap since the last event grows beyond the expected cadence.
visualization: Table of gamess with time since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights which gamess have gone quiet longer than they should for played installed games.
